tex_content.html: If $\Ric (x,t_0)\le (n-1)K$ on $B_{t_0}(x_0,r_0)$, then outside that ball \begin{equation} d_t-\triangle d\ge -(n-1)\left({2\over 3}Kr_0+r_0^{-1}\right) \end{equation} at $t_0$, in the barrier sense when necessary.
